t: You're looking at Browns, a fashion boutique at 39 Brook Street in Mayfair, set inside a Grade II listed building. Joan Burstein founded it in 1970 with her husband Sidney, and it matters because of what it did for other designers. Browns was instrumental in launching Alexander McQueen, John Galliano, Ralph Lauren and Calvin Klein in the UK market. Farfetch acquired the brand and this flagship in 2015. Today the boutique offers fashion, fine jewellery and plant based food by Alexis Gauthier, so you can make a full visit of it.
